title: Кібератаки групи UAC-0010 (Armageddon): шкідливі програми GammaLoad, GammaSteel (CERT-UA#5134)

entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A cyberespionage group linked to Russian intelligence, also known as Armageddon or Gamaredon, targeting Ukrainian entities.

entities.name: GammaLoad.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based downloader malware used by UAC-0010 to fetch subsequent malicious payloads.

entities.name: GammaSteel.PS1
entities.gloss: A PowerShell-based information stealer malware used by UAC-0010 to exfiltrate specific files.

entities.name: GammaSteel.NET
entities.gloss: .NET-based credential-theft malware used by UAC-0010 to steal authentication data from web browsers.

entities.name: HarvesterX
entities.gloss: A legacy information stealing tool used by UAC-0010 prior to the deployment of PowerShell-based variants.

entities.name: Normal.dotm
entities.gloss: The default template file for Microsoft Word that can be modified to execute malicious macros.

entities.name: Remote template injection
entities.gloss: A technique where a Microsoft Office document dynamically loads a malicious remote template containing executable macro code.

entities.name: powershell.exe
entities.gloss: The command-line shell and scripting language binary built into Windows, frequently abused by attackers.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: The Windows Script Host executable used to execute VBScript and JScript scripts on Windows systems.

entities.name: mshta.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows utility used to execute Microsoft HTML Application (HTA) files.

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: ініціюють ланцюг доставки GammaLoad.PS1 на комп'ютер жертви

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: для чого застосовується GammaSteel.PS1 та GammaSteel.NET, відповідно

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: для чого застосовується GammaSteel.PS1 та GammaSteel.NET, відповідно

relations.head: GammaSteel.PS1
relations.evidence: GammaSteel.PS1 є PowerShell-реалізацією раніше використовуваного HarvesterX

relations.head: UAC-0010
relations.evidence: у вигляді посилання (так званий "Remote template injection")
